```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"No one should worry about losing health coverage if they change or lose their job.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Families should have health insurance coverage similar to what Members of Congress enjoy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Families should not be forced to bear the burden of skyrocketing premiums.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Families should not be forced to bear the burden of unaffordable deductibles.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Families should not be forced to bear the burden of benefit limits that leave them at financial risk when they become sick.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Long-overdue mental health and addiction treatment parity will be achieved.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Chronic diseases account for 70 percent of the nation's overall health care spending.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Healthy lifestyles and disease prevention and management should be promoted, especially with health promotion programs at work and physical education in schools.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"All Americans should be empowered to promote wellness and have access to preventive services to impede the development of costly chronic conditions, such as obesity, diabetes, heart disease, and hypertension.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Chronic-care and behavioral health management should be assured for all Americans who require care coordination.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Assistance should be provided for those recovering from traumatic, life-altering injuries and illnesses.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Assistance should be provided for those with mental health and substance use disorders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Additional tobacco and substance abuse prevention should be promoted.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
